name: Lightwell workshop — Fixable Critical CVEs (build)
description: OSV/Clair-class narrative: fail builds when Scanner finds fixable Critical vulnerabilities. Pair with lightwell-dep-gate for .rhlw-* Maven pins when images are stubs.
rationale: Prefer Lightwell remediated exact-version pins (.rhlw-0000X) and rebuilt images over shipping known-fixable Critical CVEs.
remediation: Update pom.xml to remediated .rhlw-* versions (lightwell-remediated-pins), rebuild from Lightwell Remediated, re-run Pipeline lightwell-build-policy-gate.
